description: One call for a full TikTok push on ONE video: 30 community likes + up to 10 community replies (AI-drafted comments) + a 24h 'Watch & answer' quiz (viewers watch to the end and answer a counting question). Use it when the user asks for a 'full', 'full blown', 'complete' or 'combo' TikTok campaign, or for likes + replies + quiz together, instead of calling boost_post and create_watch_quiz one by one. Defaults: likes on, 10 replies, quiz for 10 correct answers. Price: likes 300 credits, replies 20 credits each (10 = 200), billed up front; the quiz bills 100 credits per CORRECT answer over 24h, up to quiz_answers (10 = up to 1,000). FLOW: (1) call WITHOUT confirmed to get the free plan and show the user the steps and credit totals; (2) after the user says yes, call again with confirmed: true. If quiz_questions are missing on the confirmed call, the tool suggests questions from the video (40 credits) and creates nothing yet: show the user each question with its evidence, let them fix the answers, then call a third time with quiz_questions and confirmed: true. Each campaign bills separately; on a partial failure the result lists what was created — never call again blindly, it would create duplicates.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approved the plan and its credit totals. Omit to get the free plan.

likes.description: Include the likes boost (30 likes, 300 credits). Default true.

post_text.description: Optional — the video caption, if known. Skips the wait on a TikTok posted under a minute ago.

product_id.description: Optional product UUID (from search_products) to tailor the replies and name the quiz.

quiz_answers.description: Watch quiz cap: how many people may answer. Billed 100 credits per CORRECT answer only. Default 10. 0 = no quiz.

quiz_duration_sec.description: Video length in seconds, or "m:ss". Omit to read it from the TikTok / YouTube page; other platforms need it.

quiz_questions.description: Counting questions with whole-number answers, confirmed by the user. Omit and the confirmed call suggests them first (40 credits).

question.description: A counting question only someone who watched can answer, e.g. 'How many times does she say "ship"?'

replies.description: Community replies (AI-drafted comments), 0–10. 20 credits each. Default 10. 0 = no replies boost.

reply_guidelines.description: Optional tone and content guidance for the replies.

spread_over_hours.description: Optional — pace each boost over this many hours instead of all at once. Same price.

video_url.description: The TikTok video URL (tiktok.com or vm.tiktok.com short link).

name: launch_tiktok_campaign
title: Launch a full TikTok campaign
